# Date & time field (`date-time-field`)

Platform date/time input.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createDateTimeField` (types in `dist/web/pickers/dateTimeField.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-datetime`: the platform's date, time, date-and-time, month or week input in the design system's box, inside a `.mh-field`. The platform does the parsing, locale formatting, keyboard entry and picker; the trailing button opens that picker (it stays out of the Tab order, since the input already opens it from the keyboard).

```ts
export function createDateTimeField(options: DateTimeFieldOptions = {}): DateTimeFieldHandle;

export interface DateTimeFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the field then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** Default `date`. */
  type?: DateTimeFieldType;
  /** In the input's own format: `2026-10-16`, `07:30`, `2026-10-16T07:30`, `2026-10`, `2026-W42`. */
  value?: string;
  min?: string;
  max?: string;
  /** In seconds for times (60 = minutes only, 1 = with seconds), days for dates. */
  step?: number;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** The button that opens the platform's picker; `false` leaves only the native control. */
  icon?: IconName | string | false;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface DateTimeFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createDateTimeField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const wakeUp = createDateTimeField({
  label: 'Wake-up light',
  type: 'time',
  value: '06:45',
  step: 60,
  helper: 'The bedroom lamp starts to brighten at this time.',
  onChange: (value) => wakeUp.setError(value ? undefined : 'Choose a time.'),
});

document.body.append(wakeUp.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { DateTimeField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function DateTimeFieldExample() {
  const [time, setTime] = useState('06:45');
  return (
    <DateTimeField
      label="Wake-up light"
      type="time"
      step={60}
      helper="The bedroom lamp starts to brighten at this time."
      error={time ? undefined : 'Choose a time.'}
      value={time}
      onChange={(event) => setTime(event.target.value)}
    />
  );
}
```
